ticker_news.title: Insider Activity at Nvidia and Palantir Speaks Volumes -- but Are Investors Willing to Listen?
ticker_news.description: Insider selling at AI giants Nvidia and Palantir raises concerns, as executives and directors have been persistent sellers of their respective company's stock for years, despite the companies' strong performance. This lack of insider buying activity is worrisome and could signal potential overvaluation or a bubble in the AI sector.
ticker_news.author: Sean Williams

ticker_news.title: Better Artificial Intelligence Stock: Oracle vs. Nvidia
ticker_news.description: Oracle and Nvidia are benefiting from the rise of AI, with both companies selected to participate in the U.S. government's Stargate program. Oracle's cloud computing business is seeing explosive growth due to AI, while Nvidia's products are critical for AI systems. Both companies have reported strong financial performances, but Nvidia's new Blackwell platform and more reasonable valuation make it the better long-term AI investment.
ticker_news.author: Robert Izquierdo

ticker_news.title: Prediction: Buying Palantir Technologies Today Will Set You Up for Life
ticker_news.description: Palantir Technologies is a financial services company that offers AI platform technology to help organizations extract insights from their data. The article argues that Palantir's stock has significant upside potential as the AI investment cycle is just getting started, with companies announcing over $325 billion in AI investments for 2025 alone.
ticker_news.author: Jake Lerch

ticker_news.title: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller -- Who Sold His Nvidia Stock Last Year -- May Be Betting on Nvidia in Another Way
ticker_news.description: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller sold his Nvidia shares last year, but may be betting on the company indirectly through investments in its customers Amazon and Alphabet, which offer Nvidia's products and services.
